phase_one.ordering: predeclared randomized strategy order within paired run blocks

required_measurements: output binding and authority event order
analysis: paired process-block confidence intervals and absolute/relative effects; retain every failed cell; no request-IID inference
capacity_scope: predefine offered-load and queue limits before claiming saturation; closed-loop client counts alone do not establish a universal capacity bound
prohibited_inference: This plan is not measured evidence. Containers on one host do not count as five physical hosts or ten independent research teams.
